name: services/crstests/student_point
description: Get points which token issuer got in node specified by node_id parameter
brief_description: Get points which token issuer got in node specified by node_id parameter

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • points - number of points;

  • automatic_points - If points are set by automatic grading, this field contains number of points returned by algorithm;

  • comment - comment;

  • grader - User that was last who edited points.

    This field references objects returned by services/users/user method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

  • student - Student whoose points are.

    This field references objects returned by services/users/user2 method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

  • last_changed - Date;

  • is_editable - True if access token issuer has permissions allowing edit this points.
errors:
• object_forbidden - access to object denied.

    Possible reasons:

    • not_visible_for_students - Currently data are not visible for students.
